# A lamp for the first repair cafe

Found the spare lamp with the broken switch and photographed the wiring before opening the housing. This can be a demonstration object at the repair cafe if the electrician approves. No live testing on the public table. [[Maintenance]]: a useful example must be safe for someone who does not know which parts are dangerous.
